shortDescription: World's largest mangrove forest — home of the Royal Bengal Tiger, creeks, and wild nature.
howToGo: Go to Khulna or Mongla by bus/train from Dhaka (6–8 hours).
Join a licensed boat tour from Mongla or Khulna jetty.
Overnight launch packages from Dhaka are also available via tour operators.
whereToStay: Overnight boat cabins (most common for tiger-trail tours)
Budget hotels in Khulna city before/after the cruise
tips: Book only authorized forest permits and guides
Do not litter; mangrove ecosystem is fragile
Mosquito repellent and light jackets are essential
Tiger sightings are rare — enjoy the journey
safety: Follow forest guide instructions; stay on boat/paths; avoid night walks alone.

shortDescription: World's longest natural sea beach — sunsets, surfing vibes, and seafood heaven.
howToGo: Direct bus from Dhaka (8–10 hours) to Cox's Bazar.
Fly Dhaka → Cox's Bazar (about 1 hour).
From Chittagong, take bus or local transport (4–5 hours).
whereToStay: Beachfront hotels on Marine Drive / Kolatoli
Resorts near Inani and Himchari for quieter stays

itinerary.title: Beach & town
activities: Seafood dinner near the beach road

itinerary.title: Himchari & Inani
activities: Morning trip to Himchari waterfall & viewpoint

tips: Book hotels early in peak season
Swim only in safer marked areas
Negotiate CNG/auto fares beforehand
Carry sunscreen and hat
transport: Bus, flight, or train+bus via Chittagong
safety: Watch sea currents; keep valuables secure on crowded beaches.

shortDescription: Cloud-kissed hills of the Chittagong Hill Tracts — sunrise above the mist.
howToGo: Dhaka → Khagrachari by bus (overnight recommended).
From Khagrachari, book a reserved jeep/Chander Gari to Sajek (3–4 hours).
Roads are hilly — start early in the day.
whereToStay: Hill cottages and bamboo resorts in Sajek
Budget rooms near Helipad viewpoint area
tips: Carry warm clothes — nights are cold
Confirm jeep return timing
Respect indigenous culture and ask before photos
Mobile network can be weak
transport: Bus to Khagrachari + Chander Gari jeep
safety: Travel in daylight on hill roads; follow local security guidance.

shortDescription: Hills, waterfalls, and tribal trails — Bangladesh's adventure capital.
howToGo: Dhaka → Bandarban by direct bus (10–12 hours).
Or Dhaka → Chittagong, then local bus to Bandarban.
For Nilgiri / remote spots, hire jeep from Bandarban town.
tips: Some areas need permits — check before travel
Hire local guides for remote treks
Pack trekking shoes and rain jacket
Avoid monsoon for waterfall treks if trails are risky
safety: Trek only with guides in remote zones; check security updates.

shortDescription: Tea capital of Bangladesh — endless gardens, seven-layer tea, and quiet nature.
howToGo: Train from Dhaka to Srimangal (scenic and popular).
Direct AC/non-AC buses from Dhaka (4–5 hours).
CNG or microbus for local sightseeing after arrival.

itinerary.title: Tea & town
activities: Evening at Nilkantha Tea Cabin area

tips: Morning light is best for tea-garden photos
Hire a guide inside Lawachara
Carry insect repellent
Weekdays are quieter than weekends
transport: Train or bus from Dhaka + CNG locally
safety: Stay on marked trails in the forest; watch for wildlife.

shortDescription: Bangladesh's only coral island — turquoise water, quiet nights, island calm.
howToGo: Reach Teknaf from Dhaka/Cox's Bazar by bus.
Take ship/ferry from Teknaf to Saint Martin (morning departure).
Return ships usually leave next afternoon — plan overnight stay.
whereToStay: Beach cottages and hotels near jetty area

itinerary.title: Explore the island
activities: Cycle or walk around the island

tips: Book ship tickets in advance in peak season
Do not take corals or harm marine life
Carry cash — ATMs are limited
Sea can be rough — check weather
transport: Bus to Teknaf + ship to island
safety: Follow ship safety rules; swim carefully in rocky/coral zones.

shortDescription: Stone collection riverside by the Meghalaya hills — picnic classic of Sylhet.
howToGo: Dhaka → Sylhet by bus or flight.
From Sylhet, hire CNG/microbus to Jaflong (1.5–2 hours).
Often combined with Bisanakandi in one day trip.
whereToStay: Day trip from Sylhet hotels (most common)
Sylhet city hotels for multi-day plans

itinerary.title: Jaflong & surroundings
activities: Hills of Meghalaya across the border landscape

tips: Start early to avoid crowds
Combine with Ratargul or Bisanakandi
Keep passport if going near border zones as advised
Avoid monsoon flood days
safety: Stay away from deep river currents; follow local advice near border.

shortDescription: Daughter of the sea — rare place to see both sunrise and sunset over the Bay.
howToGo: Dhaka → Barisal by launch (overnight romantic option) or bus.
From Barisal, bus to Kuakata (3–4 hours).
Some direct Dhaka–Kuakata bus services available.

itinerary.title: Beach arrival
activities: Sunset over the Bay of Bengal

tips: Launch journey from Dhaka is part of the experience
Winter mornings are best for clear sunrise
Less crowded than Cox's Bazar
Confirm boat trips based on tide
safety: Swim carefully; beaches can have strong waves.

shortDescription: Lake district of Bangladesh — Kaptai waters, hanging bridge, and hill culture.
howToGo: Dhaka → Rangamati by direct bus.
Or via Chittagong, then local bus to Rangamati.
Boat rides on Kaptai Lake arranged locally.

itinerary.title: Kaptai Lake day
activities: Visit islands / tribal villages with guide

tips: Negotiate boat packages clearly (hours & stops)
Carry motion comfort meds if needed for boat
Respect tribal customs
Weekends get busy at hanging bridge
safety: Wear life jackets on boats; follow local navigation rules.

shortDescription: Freshwater swamp forest — boat under a canopy of trees like a green labyrinth.
bestTime: June – September (high water) / also visitable in winter
howToGo: Reach Sylhet city first.
Hire CNG to Goainghat / Ratargul area (about 1 hour).
Take local boat into the swamp forest.
whereToStay: Day trip without overnight also common

itinerary.title: Swamp boat experience
activities: Optional Jaflong same day if early start

tips: Water level changes experience a lot by season
Go early morning for fewer crowds
Agree boat fare before boarding
Protect camera from water splash
safety: Sit steadily in boats; life jackets when provided.

shortDescription: Military-area hill resort above the clouds — one of Bangladesh's best viewpoints.
howToGo: First reach Bandarban town.
Hire jeep toward Nilgiri (about 1.5–2 hours).
Entry may require permission / ticket — confirm locally.
whereToStay: Stay in Bandarban and do sunrise day trip
tips: Fog can block views — winter mornings are clearer
Warm jacket mandatory at night
Photography rules may apply in restricted zones
Combine with Bandarban circuit
safety: Follow army/resort area guidelines; no off-limit photography.

shortDescription: Vast wetland sea of freshwater — boat villages, migratory birds, endless horizon.
howToGo: Dhaka → Sunamganj by bus.
From Sunamganj, go to Tahirpur / boat ghat.
Hire engine boat for haor cruise and overnight stay on boat.

itinerary.title: Enter the haor
activities: Night under open sky on boat

food: Fresh haor fish cooked on boat
tips: Best experience is monsoon high water
Book reliable boat with life jackets
Network is weak — inform family beforehand
Bring waterproof bags
safety: Weather can change fast; avoid storms; use life jackets.

shortDescription: UNESCO World Heritage Buddhist monastery ruins — ancient Bengal's grandeur.
howToGo: Dhaka → Jaipurhat / Naogaon by bus.
Local transport to Paharpur site.
Often combined with a Rajshahi heritage circuit.
whereToStay: Rajshahi city as a base for multi-site tour
attractions: Nearby heritage stops on Rajshahi route
tips: Hire a local guide for history context
Visit early to avoid heat
Wear comfortable walking shoes
Respect the archaeological site — no climbing restricted walls
safety: Standard travel safety; keep hydrated in heat.

shortDescription: One of Bangladesh's oldest urban archaeological sites — citadel by the Karatoya.
howToGo: Dhaka → Bogura (Bogra) by bus.
Local transport to Mahasthangarh (about 30–40 minutes).
Combine with Gokul Medh / nearby mounds.
whereToStay: Day trip from Dhaka (long but possible)
tips: Morning light is great for photography
Read museum captions for timeline context
Carry water and sun protection
Pair with Paharpur for a heritage weekend
safety: Watch your step on uneven ruins.

shortDescription: Mughal alleys, Ahsan Manzil, street food storms — history alive in narrow lanes.
howToGo: From anywhere in Dhaka, take rickshaw/CNG/Uber to Sadarghat / Islampur area.
Best explored on foot with a local guide or map.
Avoid peak traffic hours for arrival.
whereToStay: Stay in newer Dhaka and day-visit Old Dhaka
tips: Go with a buddy in crowded lanes
Keep phone and wallet secure
Fridays/holidays change opening hours for monuments
Try food from busy, popular stalls
safety: Mind pickpockets in crowds; ask locals for safe walking routes.

shortDescription: Where stone rivers meet green hills — monsoon paradise near the Meghalaya border.
howToGo: Base in Sylhet city.
CNG/microbus toward Companyganj / Bisanakandi.
Often paired with Jaflong same day.

itinerary.title: River & hills
activities: Boat on the stone river landscape

tips: Monsoon is dramatic but slippery
Confirm boat safety and life jackets
Start early with Jaflong combo plan
Keep extra clothes if you expect splash
safety: Currents rise in rain; follow boatman advice.

shortDescription: Man-made lake with island beauty — calm boat days in the Hill Tracts.
howToGo: Reach Rangamati or Kaptai area.
Hire a boat from local ghats for lake touring.
Kaptai town also reachable via Chittagong.
tips: Ask for fixed-hour boat packages
Carry sunscreen — water reflects strong light
Combine with Rangamati hanging bridge
Check fuel/time before going far
safety: Life jackets on; avoid overloaded boats.

shortDescription: Rainforest trails near Srimangal — gibbons, birds, and dense green shade.
howToGo: Stay in Srimangal.
CNG to Lawachara gate (short ride).
Enter with ticket and preferably a nature guide.
food: Return for proper lunch in town
tips: Silence improves wildlife sightings
Do not play loud music on trails
Leeches possible in wet season — prepare
Hire certified guides
safety: Stay on trails; do not feed animals.

shortDescription: Waterfall meets sea cliffs near Cox's Bazar — short trip, big views.
bestTime: June – September for waterfall; winter for viewpoints
howToGo: Base yourself in Cox's Bazar.
CNG/auto or rented bike to Himchari (south of town).
Often combined with Inani Beach.
whereToStay: No need for separate Himchari hotel usually

itinerary.title: Hills & waterfall
activities: Continue to Inani if time allows

tips: Waterfall is stronger after rains
Watch slippery rocks
Go morning to avoid heat/crowds
Great add-on to Cox's Bazar trip
safety: Careful near cliff edges and wet rocks.

shortDescription: Chandranath Hill pilgrimage & trails — sea of clouds above Chittagong.
howToGo: Dhaka → Chittagong, then local bus/CNG to Sitakunda.
Direct buses also stop near Sitakunda from Dhaka route.
Trek/jeep options toward Chandranath depending on plan.
tips: Start very early for cloud views
Wear proper trekking shoes
Festival times are extremely crowded
Carry water — climb is continuous
safety: Pace yourself on steep sections; avoid after dark on trails.
